query: Someone threatened to kill me unless I paid money. What offence may apply?

gold_references.label: Section 308
gold_references.role: extortion - putting person in fear and inducing delivery of property

acceptable_references.label: Section 351
acceptable_references.reason: criminal intimidation may also apply if money was not actually delivered

required_points: Threatening to kill unless money is paid and thereby inducing delivery of property constitutes extortion under Section 308.
Section 308(5) provides that extortion by putting a person in fear of death or grievous hurt is punishable with imprisonment up to ten years and fine.
If money was not actually delivered but the threat was made to cause alarm or force an act, criminal intimidation under Section 351 may also apply.
forbidden_points: This is only criminal intimidation and not extortion.
The offence is robbery because a threat to kill was used.

notes: Scenario query. Extortion under Section 308 is the primary provision.
